title: Participation Chargeback Provisions of the Dealer Retail Agreements
content:
A contract's participation is charged back at most once per chargeback reason, and the total charged back on a contract never exceeds 100 percent of the participation paid on it. These provisions govern every participation chargeback under the Dealer Retail Agreements.

## Provisions

**1. Early payoff.** A payoff (including a refinance payoff) within 90 days of the contract date charges back all of the participation (early payoff); a payoff later but within 180 days of the contract date charges back 50 percent. For every tier a payoff by refinance with another lender is treated as an early payoff.

**2. Early default.** A repossession or charge-off within 120 days of the contract date charges back all of the participation (early default).

**3. First-payment default.** A first installment not paid within 30 calendar days of its due date charges back the tier's first-payment default chargeback percent (first-payment default).

**4. Unwind.** An unwind charges back 100 percent (contract unwound).

**5. Several reasons.** When several reasons apply to one contract, the one with the highest percent is charged and the others are not, so the cap is never exceeded.

**6. Collection.** Chargebacks are deducted from the dealer's next funding; invoiced when no funding occurs within the chargeback invoice period — that is, invoiced after 30 calendar days without a funding.

**7. Limits.** A contract's participation is charged back at most once per chargeback reason: where the company's record already shows a chargeback for that reason on that contract, it is not charged back again for that reason. The largest total chargeback on one contract is 100 percent of the participation paid.

## Schedule

| Chargeback reason | Event and window | Share of the participation charged back |
|---|---|---|
| Early payoff | Payoff, including a refinance payoff, within 90 days of the contract date | All (100 percent) |
| Early payoff | Payoff later than 90 days but within 180 days of the contract date | 50 percent |
| Early default | Repossession or charge-off within 120 days of the contract date | All (100 percent) |
| First-payment default | First installment not paid within 30 calendar days of its due date | The tier's percent, below |
| Contract unwound | Unwind | 100 percent |

First-payment default chargeback percent by tier:

| Dealer Program Bronze | Dealer Program Silver | Dealer Program Gold | Dealer Program Platinum | Dealer Program Diamond | Dealer Program Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 50 | 50 |

Each chargeback is recorded once per contract per reason, with its date, the amount charged back, the reason and the share of the participation charged back; it decreases the agreement's net participation balance.

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs)

Each case assumes a participation paid on the contract of 300.00, chosen for illustration only.

| Case | Reason and percent | Charged back |
|---|---|---|
| Paid off 60 days after the contract date | Early payoff, all | 300.00 |
| Refinanced with another lender 60 days after the contract date | Treated as an early payoff, all | 300.00 |
| Paid off 150 days after the contract date | Early payoff, 50 percent | 150.00 |
| Repossessed 100 days after the contract date | Early default, all | 300.00 |
| First installment still unpaid 40 calendar days after its due date, on a Dealer Program Diamond agreement | First-payment default, 50 percent | 150.00 |

**Several reasons on one contract.** On a Dealer Program Diamond agreement (hypothetical participation 300.00), a contract whose first installment was not paid within 30 calendar days of its due date and which was repossessed 110 days after the contract date meets both first-payment default (50 percent) and early default (all). The highest percent, early default at 100 percent, is charged: 300.00. The first-payment default is not charged, and the total stays within 100 percent of the participation paid.

**Collection.** A chargeback (hypothetical) is booked and the dealer is funded for another contract 12 days later: the chargeback is deducted from that funding. Had no funding occurred within 30 calendar days, the chargeback would be invoiced.
